sources.title: Effect of Computer-Assisted Cognitive Behavior Therapy vs Usual Care on Depression Among Adults in Primary Care: A Randomized Clinical Trial
sources.population: 175 adult primary-care patients with PHQ-9 scores of 10 or greater; the study included substantial representation of lower-income participants.
sources.design: Randomized clinical trial of clinician-supported computer-assisted CBT plus treatment as usual versus treatment as usual, with 12 weeks of active treatment and follow-up.
sources.scope_limitations: Specific computer-assisted CBT program with therapist telephone support in primary care. It does not establish that every form of CBT, unguided self-help, or this repository's exercises produce the same effect.

sources.title: Psychotherapies for Generalized Anxiety Disorder in Adults: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis of Randomized Clinical Trials
sources.population: Adults aged 18 years or older with a primary diagnosis of generalized anxiety disorder; 65 randomized clinical trials and 5048 participants contributed to the network meta-analysis.
sources.design: Systematic review and random-effects network meta-analysis comparing psychotherapies with each other and control conditions; certainty was evaluated with CINeMA.
sources.scope_limitations: Pooled psychotherapy evidence. Aggregate CBT estimates must not be assumed to apply identically to every CBT protocol or delivery format.

sources.title: CBT treatment delivery formats for generalized anxiety disorder: a systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
sources.population: 4361 participants with generalized anxiety disorder across 52 randomized trials; mean age 43 years and 69.7% women.
sources.design: Pairwise and network meta-analysis of randomized trials comparing individual, group, remote and other CBT delivery formats with controls.
sources.scope_limitations: Delivery-format comparison. Results distinguish individual, group and remote CBT and therefore should not be flattened into a single generic CBT effect.

sources.title: Cognitive behavioral therapies are evidence-based - based on what? A systematic review and meta-analysis of recent randomized controlled trials of cognitive behavioral therapies for depression
sources.population: Samples with a formal diagnosis of depression in randomized controlled trials published from 2019 through 2023; 62 independent samples were represented.
sources.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of recent superiority randomized controlled trials of classic and contemporary CBTs for depression.
sources.scope_limitations: Restricted to formally diagnosed depression and superiority trials from the specified publication window. Reported effect ranges should not be treated as a guarantee for an individual or every CBT implementation.

sources.title: The 2020 Royal Australian and New Zealand College of Psychiatrists clinical practice guidelines for mood disorders
sources.scope_limitations: Historical reference only. The issuing College now states that this guideline is more than five years old and no longer considered current guidance.

sources.title: Mood disorders clinical practice guideline
sources.scope_limitations: Current status page for the historical mood-disorders guideline. It states that the 2020 guideline is more than five years old and no longer considered current guidance.
